svg.title: SevaForge v3.0 — Cloud-Deployed Architecture (Azure)
svg.text: LAYER 4 — Pipeline Agents (AKS Pods — KEDA Autoscaled)
LAYER 6 — External AI Providers (via Azure AI Model Catalog)
CLI/API → Front Door → WAF + Entra ID → AKS (MissionControl) → Agent Pods → Azure OpenAI → Azure PG/Blob → Response
Service Bus async pipeline • Azure PG pgvector for RAG • Managed Identity (no secrets) • Front Door WAF + DDoS
AKS + KEDA event-driven autoscaling • Service Bus handles backpressure • Azure Cache caches LLM responses
